amendment_reasoning.statement_1: Historical v1.0.0 CONTROL evidence cannot be assumed to represent the corrected v1.0.1 exit lifecycle.
amendment_reasoning.statement_2: The old resolver could prevent progression into the runner-target evaluation path when partial-target geometry failed closed.
basis: Historical CONTROL evidence (GEN_001, GEN_002A, and the GEN_002 corroboration cited by HYP_002's closure) was generated under the v1.0.0 outcome resolver, whose partial-target direction mapping was later found and remediated as INVERSE_BOUNDARY (artifacts/validation/ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1/V1_0_1_REMEDIATION/V1_0_1_REMEDIATION_MANIFEST.json).
The v1.0.1 remediation corrected the partial-target semantic to OPPOSITE_SESSION_BOUNDARY (src/session_sweep_continuation/outcome_resolution.py, commit 02d7b29).

Read directly from src/session_sweep_continuation/outcome_resolution.py (resolve_campaign_entry): a null/invalid partial-target geometry routes an occurrence to _resolve_full_position_only, a code path that evaluates stop-loss vs. session-exit only and does not evaluate runner_target_r. The partial-target-gated Phase 2 path is the only code path that ever evaluates runner_target_r.

Because partial-target activation therefore controls progression into the runner-target evaluation path, and the v1.0.0 partial-target mapping was defective, the historical CONTROL arm (runner_target_r=3.0, generated under v1.0.0) cannot be treated as clean evidence for the corrected v1.0.1 lifecycle.
explicit_non_claims: No claim is made about how many occurrences in GEN_001/GEN_002A/GEN_002 were routed through the fail-closed path -- this has not been measured under this amendment and is not asserted as a specific count.
No claim is made about what R multiple the corrected engine would have produced for any historical occurrence.
No claim is made that profitability or net/gross expectancy would improve, worsen, or stay the same under the corrected CONTROL arm.
No claim is made about the direction or magnitude of any economic delta between pre- and post-remediation CONTROL economics.
Magnitude and direction of the effect are explicitly UNKNOWN and are not estimated, bounded, or implied by this amendment.
